gameplan: Early: place at least one Elixir Collector behind a princess/king when the lane is calm. Defense with Ice Wizard, Mega Minion, Princess, Barbarians; use Sparky vs tanks. Main combo: Sparky behind the king, then Giant IN FRONT of Sparky before the bridge — never let Sparky cross alone. Support with Princess / Ice Wizard / Mega Minion when elixir allows. Zap for swarms, Inferno reset, and sparky-stun value.

cards.name: Sparky
cards.visual: Round purple electric cannon on wheels, big spark coil on top, often purple evo glow. NOT a flying unit.
cards.usage: Place BEHIND the king tower to charge safely. Core of the push — wait for Giant to tank in front before the bridge. Also drop on defense vs heavy tanks (Golem/Giant/PEKKA) when you can protect her charge.

cards.name: Giant (Evo)
cards.visual: Huge pink/flesh tanky humanoid with small head, club, purple EVOLUTION border/glow. Tall body filling most of the card art. NOT the small Ice Wizard, NOT Mega Minion.
cards.usage: MUST walk in front of Sparky before crossing the bridge. Place at the bridge or just in front of a charging Sparky so Sparky never leads. Also soak for counter-pushes after a good defense.

cards.name: Zap (Evo)
cards.visual: Yellow lightning bolt spell icon, often with evolution purple effect. Flat spell card, not a troop.
cards.usage: Reset Inferno Tower/Dragon, stun Sparky mirrors, clear Goblin Barrel / bats / skarmy at the tower, finish low HP. Aim on cluster or in front of ground swarms walking down.

cards.name: Princess
cards.visual: Blonde girl with pink dress and longbow, area-shot archer princess. Distinct from Ice Wizard (blue) and Musketeer.
cards.usage: Chip at the bridge, defend swarms from a safe depth, support Sparky/Giant push from behind. Prefer opposite bridge or behind the tank — never dive alone into Log range if avoidable.

cards.name: Ice Wizard
cards.visual: Small blue wizard with icy staff and white/blue beard, freeze theme. Much smaller than Giant. NOT purple Mega Minion.
cards.usage: Primary defensive slow. Place in front of the threatened tower or behind king to kite. Excellent support walking behind Giant/Sparky on offense.

cards.name: Barbarians
cards.visual: Group of multiple blonde shirtless barbarians with swords in one card art (swarm of 5).
cards.usage: Surround tanks, Hog, Ram, or Royal Giant. Drop on the path of the threat (not stacked on the tower). Can counter-push if many survive.

cards.name: Elixir Collector
cards.visual: Pink/purple elixir pump building with tank and pipes, generates elixir droplets. Building card, not a troop.
cards.usage: PRIORITY in the first minutes: place at least one when the board is calm. Always farm behind king / safe tile when there is no urgent threat. Do NOT place if a big enemy push is already crossing — defend first.

cards.name: Mega Minion (Evo)
cards.visual: Single FLYING purple/blue fat minion with bat wings, often purple EVOLUTION glow. Air unit — not Giant, not Ice Wizard, not ground.
cards.usage: Air and mid-HP defense. Place in front of threatened tower or as flying support behind Giant/Sparky. Strong vs Balloons, lava pups, and support troops.

phases.single_elixir: Open with Elixir Collector when calm (at least one early). Defend cheaply with Ice Wizard / Mega Minion / Princess / Barbs. Build Sparky behind king only when you can afford Giant to tank before the bridge. Never send Sparky alone.
phases.double_elixir: Faster Collector + bigger Sparky+Giant stacks. Support with Princess / Ice Wizard / Mega Minion behind the tank. Zap value on swarms and Inferno resets.
phases.overtime: Force the Sparky+Giant combo; defend desperately with Barbs/Ice Wiz/Mega Minion. Zap for clutch resets. Pump only if both lanes are completely empty.
